notes.title: Quick update before new major changes
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi all. Long time no post :P[/h1]

[b]UPDATE: New update is now live.[/b]

[b]I have been working on other projects so have not had time to fix LBA. In the past couple of weeks I have added a couple of things to LBA though that I know has probably pissed people off since I launched the game back in 2018.
[/b]
So with no further ado, I am current making the build that fixes hit registration from the AI. This has plagued the game since I wrote the AI systems and I know it must piss people right off that they dont know where the AI is when they are being shot at. It makes it feel like they are shooting you from nowhere and through buildings (which is not the case I assure you. The AI I have written are amazingly good at LBA and they will fight each other and you like pros!).

I have added in a new directional hit detection. This will show you where the AI is shooting from - this makes life allot easier when fighting the AI. I have also increased the jump height (doubled it infact). This will help with evasion from your foes and makes jumping look allot better. I have changed a couple of other things with the animations as well but this was just housekeeping.

So whats next for LBA.

I am going to be scrapping the current maps and making 1 big battle arena - yes I already have 1 big map done but I never optimised it while building it so the lag and FPS situation with it is very very bad. I have tried to fix this but its a massive task so I would be better to build a new map. Before this though, I am still using an old version of Unity to build LBA and this is starting to cause issues. I need to fully remove the mutiplayer system and replace it. This is not a huge undertaking but it will take a while. I am then going to make a new large scale openworld map. I have been making a mutiplayer system for another idea I have if this works, I will be using it for the new LBA system.

According to my stats, the game is still being downloaded daily by (allot of) new players but the average play time is pretty low. I suspect this is due to the hit detection system so the new system should improve player retention.

Any way, more news coming soon. I will be streaming the new version here in the LBA page as soon as its built!

notes.title: LINX BATTLE ARENA: MAJOR UPDATE RELEASED
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30433631/4c5e429fc2711c8cbd32f344a8700b480e27f963.png[/img]

Finally I am releasing the update for Linx Battle Arena. This update will include the new DLC, major stability updates, 24 new characters, new gun system, a complete new NPC and AI enemy system, improved multiplayer networking, a bespoke ranking and progress system, new skill based play system, achievements and a shed load of other behind the scenes improvements.

[h1]Get Your Rank and Achievements[/h1]
Show off your skills to your fellow players with achievements and ranks!

Ranks can be achieved during play by killing enemies, living like a boss, not killing NPC's and general skilful play. There are currently 15 rank badges. 

[i][b]Achievements are now available for your hard work[/b][/i]
Weapon specific, kills and deaths, NPC slaughter and much more fun activities will help you gain the current batch of Achievements. or Be Like Dave ːsteammockingː

[h1]Skill Levels[/h1]
While Linx Battle Arena does not have a big learning curve, it does require skill to master the art of killing. You can now set your skill levels to suit your play abilities and change them to suit as you get better (or worse). AI skill and tactics will change depending on your chosen skill levels. Higher ranked players choosing to play in low skill matches against AI will gain no rewards. Lower ranked players choosing to play in higher skill levels will gain higher rewards. Skill levels do NOT effect multiplayer games.

[h1]Weapon updates and improvements[/h1]

[b]Get the Goldilocks effect from a tight, diverse range of guns.[/b]

LBA now offers 6 weapon types to suit your play style.

Pick up coin crates, take your cash to the vendors and buy your gun of choice.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30433631/ab4a75f246b15cf471db2b977e8490905504d698.png[/img]

[b][i]New in this update is the Gillan P30 Carbine[/i][/b]
This semi auto killer gives fast target acquisition and packs a punch that will see your enemies crumbling before you. The Semi Auto fire action will give you a medium to fast recharge rate.

All original LBA guns have also had an overhaul giving more predictable results across the full range.

[b][i]More new guns will be added soon so keep an eye on the gun vendors![/i][/b]

[h1]The local residents..[/h1]
The local residents in the Arenas are not there for your target practice! You need to treat these people well and NOT kill them. Granted the odd bullet might take off a head or two in the heat of battle but killing the residents of the arenas will see you being punished with reduced rank. Although there may be some benefits to the occasional killing spree. See the new achievements for more info.

[h1]Improved Multiplayer[/h1]
Nothing beats inviting your friends in to the arenas and teaching them who is the real boss. Invite up to 9 of your friends for a battle to the death. Unique to LBA: Lucky Dip, Guns for Cash, Timed Rounds and Set Lives are all interchangeable so you play just the way you want.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30433631/f7fc4a6aaa0eeacc636a60712b626324ad6d3925.jpg[/img]
[h1]The First New DLC - 24 Characters[/h1]
[i][b]Stand out from the crowd with 24 new characters to choose from.[/b]

The characters range from casual male and female characters, Swat Team and Zombie Characters. Buy them now and get them instantly activated in game. More new characters coming very soon![/i]

notes.title: LBA: MASSIVE UPDATE INCOMING!! Oh and some news :P
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30433631/e961c0d435ac5213da09c7836f307c8557dc804c.png[/img]

WALL OF TEXT AHEAD
[TL;DR]
Big updates, new stuff coming soon, check out some new pwetty pictures...


[h1][b]So on to the major news etc :)[/b][/h1]

Its been a long long almost 5 years since I first came up with this idea of making a third person shooter that 'I' would love to play. Well the game I wanted to make is so close I can almost smell it!

I have been working allot, and I mean ALLOT on LBA in the past few months. The game runs like butter off a hot knife, the guns feel like they should and the new AI system that I have built from absolute scratch in the past 2 months feels almost exactly how I want the AI to feel in LBA.

I have been doing a hell of allot of play testing recently just to actually play LBA and I can honestly say the result is better than I though it could be. So whats so special about this new LBA in comparison to the current version you can download from Steam right now?

Well I would consider the version I released on Steam almost a year and a half ago, which is still today the actual live version people are downloading and playing, to be an ALPHA version of the game I am about to release to the world.

I am considering this NEW BEGINNING release of LBA to be almost (95%) the game I wanted to release around 18 months ago.

[h1]Whats new in LBA:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Completely new scoring and ranking system
[*] All scores are saved on STEAM so no need for offsite services in any way!
[*] 5 Skill levels determine your rewards and scores
[*] Completely new AI system with variable skill engagement algorithm
[*] Completely reworked movement system
[*] Completely reworked aiming and target acquisition system
[*] Reworked camera movement and character follow system
[*] New environmental effects for a more natural look and feel
[*] New character reaction sounds for diegetic effect
[*] New hit indicator on hud
[*] The 6 original LBA Characters revamped
[*] TONS of optimisation
[/list]

All of the above will be free with the new patch.

[b]PAID DLC[/b]
[list]
[*] 24 new characters to choose from (will be paid DLC - 1 payment, get all 24!)
[*] [i][b]HUGE NEW MAP[/b][/i] - Teriach Island is now an actual fully working map** (will be paid DLC)
[/list]
[i][b]** About Teriach Island[/b]

Teriach Island is a 1 mile x 1 mile island that I built for the original game. It has a back story which I wont go in to right now. The 4 maps used in LBA come from Teriach Island (this was the original name for the game) so when you get in to play the map you will see where the 4 current 'Arenas' came from. Teriach Island also has a town area, a docks/shipping area and a trailer/caravan park. Teriach Island will have its own specific rule set, challenges and rewards. More details will be announced very soon![/i]

[h1]Reward Scheme[/h1]
Want to earn exclusive item rewards in LBA like access to exclusive characters? I will be introducing a loyalty scheme soon. You will be rewarded for your loyalty patron! :) more details coming soon.

[h1]JOIN THE NEW DISCORD CHANNEL![/h1]
[url=https://discord.gg/qZ6W9D5]https://discord.gg/qZ6W9D5[/url]
The new Discord Channel is live now. Please feel free to jump on a give me your feedback. Or if your looking to play with other LBA players then this is the best place to hook up. Its a waist land right now.. every Discord channel starts like this so dont be put off.. [i][b]If you post something, people will answer..[/b][/i]
[url=https://discord.gg/qZ6W9D5][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30433631/51801fc416b7359f79d0e30256757678328f8920.png[/img][/url]

 

[h1]Moving forward[/h1]

As we move forward in to 2019, I will be adding some fun events and challenges. I will announce these in the forum and here as announcements. LBA is being downloaded around 50 times per week. I understand that people will be put off by the current state of the game (Shit I would too. Its BROKEN!!!) but this major overhaul and new improvements are geared towards more player entertainment and fulfilment and a smoother experience all round so I am hoping that people will start to give me more feedback and help direct the progress.

[h1][b]Some Screenies[/b][/h1]
Here is a couple of sneak peek screenshots. You can see allot more screenies in the screenshot gallery right here on Steam.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30433631/f7fc4a6aaa0eeacc636a60712b626324ad6d3925.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30433631/3b3f64733d5a8b7ba0936b5463975007cfe03af2.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30433631/0441b6865ada619ba8ddee2095e85e7976ae2b40.jpg[/img]

[i]Quick footnote. I have made no profit at all from LBA. This is pretty much a labour of love for me and I am going to continue to build and add to LBA for the foreseeable future. The money I have made from LBA from sales has been less than beer tokens but I did not start to make LBA to become some rich mega super start Game Dev.. Im sure I will sell some DLC's for the game. This may or may not help me finance the game moving forward. If it doesnt then so be it. I will still continue to work on the game and I hope the people that play it have a good time doing so. I know I have enjoyed the challenge of making the game from concept, to the first working builds to the state it is in right now and I have had some amazing times over the years playing with the game testers. I really want to give a big thanks to everyone who has helped me progress to this stage. [/i]

LBA FTW!

[i][b]LBA: NEW BEGINNING RELEASE DATE - Coming very very soon...[/b][/i]

notes.title: Going Free To Play and other changes
notes.notes:
First up, I took LBA in the wrong direction after the release. I took it in a direction that was not really suited to the game. In-fact I kind of had rose tinted glasses on while taking the game in that direction and spent far too much time doing that! This drew me in to a slump where I felt like I had done too much to go back but I do back pretty much everything up as I go so I have the builds from just after release and I am going back to PRE single player (see next paragraph) where I have implemented the best NEW features.


The game build as is right now has lots of AI wandering round Teriach Island, different cars, missions, a large open world and is purely single player based. This is not what I ever intended for LBA and so I have scrapped that version (i still have it of course but it will most likely never be released). It is pretty decent fun to play BUT again, not what LBA was ever meant to be so its pointless and has been a waist of time.

[b]Moving forward![/b]
What I am going to do is make the game free to play and make ingame cosmetics purchasable (this will include characters and clothing and some other stuff which will be announced soon enough). I did allot of work on the character creation system which was working pretty well. This allowed you to personalise your characters appearance and clothing.

I am also going to remove the current scoring system as it is pretty much pointless and use Steam Achievements and Steam scoring instead. This will show people what you have actually done in the game with Achievement icons instead of just boring numbers.

everything is still work in progress and as I am still working alone on the game, things take allot more time than if I had say 5 guys working with me.

I will hopefully be able to get a road map done soon to let people see what I am looking to get done and in what order.

LBA will probably never be finished. What I mean by this is that it will for ever be evolving in some way BUT it will always be playable as a multiplayer game.

More news coming very soon..

notes.title: Release 1.0 - Get LBA for $1
notes.notes:
[h1]Linx Battle Arena - 1.0[/h1]
[b]So as you may have read in my previous announcement, I was going to ditch LBA but I have been getting emails from people and messages here on Steam all weekend asking me to NOT bin LBA.[/b]

I do not want to get rid of the game and it would seem that I have a silent community just waiting for something to happen (that I never knew about). I would like to thank everyone who has contacted me asking me to keep working on LBA. I would also like to thank the occasional troll for entertaining me by telling me that me and my team need to stop making this game! Me and my non existent team thank you as well :P

I am going to release LBA as 1.0 release on Monday 29 January (which to me is tomorrow). I will make the 1.0 release live at 5pm GMT for $1.

[h1]Moving Forward[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30433631/e527412c3693298679e58ec7c0c7f42f952917b4.png[/img]
The game I am playing locally and building is bigger than 1.0 in many ways. If all goes well, I will be adding to the live game in the next 2 months all of the features I have built which are working for me pretty well, but have minimal UI and are still a but clunky. The list of new Coming Soon features include:
[list]
[*]missions
[*]car racing games
[*]more vehicles
[*]a much larger open world map which combined all current districts/areas
[*]customisation of characters (male and female)
[*]much improved environmental effects
[*]better mechanics
[*]lots of NPCs which dress using the same clothes as our characters
[*]more things to do in single player mode apart from shooting or getting gunned down by BOTS!
[*]Steam Achievements
[*]Steam Trading Cards
[/list]

Linx Battle Arena is still work in progress but release 1.0 has been played by me and my testers ALLOT so this version is great for playing in a group with mates although you can get a good feel for the game in single player training mode as well!

 I am working to make a game that I personally like to play and this is what I have achieved so far. when I release the game tomorrow there will be bugs I dont know about, there will be crazy stuff going on that I never fore-scene but once I get more people in to the game and you all start telling me "SEEDY WTF DUDE - I just tried to do this and the guys leg fell off and walked away its self!" I will get a quicker and much better idea of how you are all playing it and how I am going to fix these issues.

[h1]Help me test new toys[/h1]
As I am building this game alone and have very few testers that can help regularly, I am always on the lookout for more people to try the game out in my closed test world. If you would like to help me try out new stuff like new cars, new guns, new gear, new maps and lots of other new new new! then please hit me up in the forum here on steam. Being a tester will get you the first look and feel for the new stuff I make and add to the game.

More news coming very soon...
